validity.recommendation: revise Owner1% away from 100.00% -- source says 'Various'; do not paste 100% as a flat corroborated value
validity.researcher_notes: The sheet's Owner1=Enterprise Products Partners / Owner1%=100.00% is NOT supported by Enterprise's own SEC 10-K, which is the best available primary source for this exact system. The same filing that confirms length/capacity states the Texas Intrastate System's 'Ownership Interest' as 'Various (5)', with footnote (5): 'We proportionately consolidate our undivided interests, which range from 22% to 80%, in 1,471 miles of the Texas Intrastate System... The remainder of our Texas Intrastate System is wholly owned.' So ~1,471 of the 6,770 miles (21.7%) are held as undivided joint interests at 22-80% (mixed across segments, not one blended percentage), and only the remaining ~5,299 miles (78.3%) are wholly (100%) owned by Enterprise. I searched the filing's other undivided-interest footnotes (which elsewhere name a co-owner, e.g. 'Port Arthur ... Pipeline Company, L.L.C.' for a different asset) -- no co-owner is named for the Texas Intrastate System's undivided-interest segments in this document, so I cannot propose a specific replacement Owner2. Enterprise is unambiguously the correct PRIMARY owner and sole operator of record ('We operate our natural gas pipelines... with the exception of the White River Hub, Old Ocean Pipeline and certain segments of the Texas Intrastate System') -- this is not a wrong-operator or duplicate issue, only an overstated ownership percentage on an aggregate multi-segment system. Recommend an Update-leg follow-up to identify the JV partner(s) on the 1,471-mile undivided-interest portion (likely findable in an older EPD 10-K footnote or an FERC/RRC filing naming the specific joint pipeline), or at minimum annotate Owner1% as approximate/majority rather than 100%.

validity.recommendation: soften StartYear1=1960 to reflect that no source pins down an exact year; treat as decade-level inference, not a hard-sourced precise date
validity.researcher_notes: StartYear1=1960 asserts more precision than any available source supports. GEM's own gem.wiki narrative (read for leads only, never cited) itself says only 'first operational in the 1960s' -- a decade, not a specific year -- and none of the four harvested citations (Enterprise's SEC 10-K, its since-moved ops page, RBN Energy, A Barrel Full) states a specific founding year; the 10-K is a financial/regulatory disclosure and does not discuss original pipeline construction dates for legacy assets it later assembled/acquired into this aggregate system. Enterprise Products the COMPANY was founded in 1968 (per Wikipedia and company history materials), which is itself LATER than 1960, meaning at least some component pipe predates Enterprise's own founding and was acquired from a predecessor operator -- plausible for an intrastate system built up from legacy assets, but it means '1960' cannot be Enterprise's own construction date and is unverified as anyone's construction date. This is a low-severity spec caveat, not an existence or duplicate issue -- flagging so the exact year isn't treated as independently corroborated.
